scientific limitations/integrity: The equilibrium-line statement is an exact algebraic correction for the published vector field and also applies to constant solutions of its fractional analogue. The invariant-measure identities are restricted to the classical integer-order autonomous flow and do not assert existence or attraction of a non-equilibrium recurrent set. The result does not negate the reported hyperchaos; it identifies the zero eigenvalue as tangent to a line of equilibria and supplies a global stationary constraint. A residual literature risk remains that the cited four-dimensional base system could contain a related balance, but checked accessible sources did not cover the full source-specific equilibrium correction and shell law.
title: Equilibrium-line correction and an exact stationary shell law for a 5D memristive flow
